title: Steps declare the authority they write: the run derives from intent x seat
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied (GATE IT): app/api/brand/route.ts + brand-route.test.ts joined the write set; PUT now asks requireOrgCapability('org:manage') after requireOperator and before the limiter. No new error code was needed: requireOrgCapability already answers the registered FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITY (403, capability as data), which is in all four catalogs, so api-response.ts was not touched. The ratchet app/api/route-capability-coverage.test.ts failed on the now-gated brand route ('GATED but still listed in ALLOWED'), so its allowlist line was replaced with a closure comment; a sibling (pipeline-api/A) had an uncommitted hunk in the same file, so only my hunk was committed (temp index + git apply --cached) and their hunk is intact in the working tree. Acceptance 9 = the card's 8 + the brand 403/owner-200 case. Seat is read only in live mode (useSetupDraft's fetch is live-only), so preview runs with a null seat = the full run. perf-budget.json app/page.tsx raised 1421 -> 1422 modules (setupSeat.ts); KB unchanged.
notes: Cases red before: 7 of 9 at runtime (owner-seat and null-seat relevantSteps cases pin today's run and passed before; all 9 were red at the type level: no seat field). Owner path unchanged by construction: open mode folds to OWNER_CAPS in both resolvers (route.test.ts pins org:manage + members:manage in the open-mode seat), a null seat fails open, and the owner/null runs keep all six steps, so the journey-role-to-schedule e2e stays on its six-step walk. Gates: tsc exits 2 only on the untracked kpi-sim/ directory (pre-existing, not in git); the earlier jobs-browse/useJobsList reds were a sibling's in-flight work and cleared. test:perf on the shared checkout is red on app/page.tsx KB (8993 vs 8992) and ~14 api routes (+3-4 KB) from siblings' UNCOMMITTED files: a git archive of HEAD bf7b02d8f + only this card's files measures 1422 modules / 8982 KB with zero findings. review:constitution over 36c7beedb..HEAD: 0 blocking; it did not flag the brand route. Follow-ups (outside write set, not done): app/features/shell/navCapabilities.ts header still says 'Branding is deliberately ABSENT: its door (PUT /api/brand) gates on requireOperator' - now false; adding branding: 'org:manage' to TAB_CAPABILITY would stop offering the branding editor to admins who now get the coded 403. app/api/write-capability-gate.test.ts could add a viewer-403 drive for PUT /api/brand (brand-route.test.ts already drives recruiter 403 / owner 200).
